description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView component used for displaying log data in an Android application. It implements the LogNode interface to format and present log entries with various priorities, tags, messages, and exceptions.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs formatted log data received through the LogNode interface, displaying logs with various priorities, tags, and exceptions.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data including priority, tag, message, and exception, then updates the LogView UI with the log entry.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
